example.prompt: A ceramic coffee mug on a clean studio background

aspect_ratio.description: 1:1, 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16, 5:4, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9 or 21:9. Use with resolution; omit for automatic framing.

image_urls.description: Input image URLs, up to 8. Each must be the image_url returned by uploading the image to POST /proxy/krea/assets (multipart form field `file`); any link that is not an https URL on the host app-uploads.krea.ai, including your own https URLs, is rejected with 400, and an app-uploads.krea.ai link that is not a live upload fails with a 5xx error. Omit for text-to-image.

prompt.description: What to generate. With image_urls, the editing instruction; describe what should change and what should stay the same.

regional_edit.description: Set true for a local edit that keeps the rest of the image. Needs model berry and at least one image in image_urls.

thinking_mode.description: fast (default), high or ultra. High and ultra plan complex edits in more detail and take longer. Ultra needs resolution 2k.
